description: Omgevingsverordening- Nautisch vaarwegbeheer is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geodata.gelderland.nl. The contours of De Linge and the Oude IJssel are part of the environmental regulation to show where the nautical management of these waterways lies. This file was adopted on 15 November 2023 by the Provincial States and entered into force on 1 January 2024 under the Environmental Law. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Environmental Ordinance- Nautical Waterway Management" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2024-01-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
